# SnapLogic Company Overview

## Powering the Agentic Enterprise

## Who We Are

SnapLogic powers the agentic enterprise. The company’s Agentic Integration and Applied AI Platform serves as the AI operational layer for the enterprise, securely connecting applications, data, APIs and AI agents across cloud, on-premise and hybrid environments. Founded in 2006 by Gaurav Dhillon (co- founder of Informatica) and headquartered in San Mateo, California, SnapLogic pioneered the vision that integration should be fast, visual, and accessible to every team.

Today, SnapLogic leads the market in AI-powered integration and automation, trusted by Global 2000 enterprises across Financial Services and Banking, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Retail, Manufacturing, Technology, and the Public Sector.

## Scale & Reach

SnapLogic operates globally, with teams and customers spanning North America and the EMEA and APAC regions, giving enterprises a consistent platform experience wherever their operations sit. That footprint supports hundreds of enterprise customers, including many Global 2000 companies that depend on the platform for mission-critical work. Every month, the platform processes billions of documents and API calls across those customer environments, re�ecting the volume enterprises trust it to handle day in and day out. Leading investors back the company, including Andreessen Horowitz, 6th Street, and Ignition Partners, giving SnapLogic the staying power to keep scaling alongside the enterprises it serves.

## The Platform

One native foundation powers three integrated capabilities, working together as a single connected system across the enterprise. Integration lets teams deploy connections in hours using 1000+ pre-built Snaps, with no coding required. Automation eliminates manual work across ERP, CRM, HCM, and data warehouses through enterprise-grade orchestration. AI-native and agentic scale lets teams build and govern AI Agents with AgentCreator and SnapCode, generate pipelines from plain-language prompts with SnapGPT, and connect and govern agents through the SnapLogic MCP Server and Enterprise MCP.
